$comment: Water as a surface grid (docs/WATER_SURFACE_GRID.md, ADR 0060): a depth per 1 m column moving to its neighbours by the local-inertial law, in sleeping water chunks of 16 x 16 columns. Rates are real and counted in game time (the day/night clock's: a 20-minute day is 72x real time) x the world's water speed (`speed`, the default of the server's `water_speed`). tickEvery: server ticks per water tick. theta: the face law's weighting (1 the plain scheme, below 1 damped; de Almeida et al. 2012). cfl: a substep's share of the time a wave takes to cross a column. maxSubsteps: the most substeps a water tick takes (more, and the water runs slow that tick). sleepBandM: a chunk sleeps once no level in it moved more than this over calmS water s (tight: a chunk asleep off its level gives it back as a wave). wakeBandM: how far a sleeping chunk's account (what its awake neighbours sent it) may move its water before it wakes. releaseS: a woken chunk takes what it owes over this long, by depth. jumpM2s: a shared face's change in a substep (m2/s) that wakes a sleeping chunk at once. releaseM: a free column this far off its rest frees the held water beside it, so a change spreads as far as it reaches. editReach: an edit frees the water within this many columns. fillHysteresis: how far past half a drawn step (in the liquid's fill steps) a level must move before its cells are written again. currentStillMs: water slower than this (m/s) has no current (docs/WATER_SURFACE_GRID.md §2c). currentDepthM: water shallower than this (m) has no current, a wet film's flow over its depth being noise. riverCurrentMaxMs: the fastest an untouched river's current runs (m/s; its speed is Manning's on the map river's fall at the column's depth, and a steep chute's would be a torrent; 1.5 leaves a swimmer at the swim layer's 3 m/s headway upstream). stepBudget: the most column-substeps a water tick may take (its substeps times its awake columns, at least one substep): water runs on game time, a tick of it is seconds of water, and many awake chunks could take the server longer than a tick; past the budget the rest of the tick's water time is lost (the water runs slow, not the game). Only where the water runs on the server's own thread (inline: tests, a fallback); on its own thread (ADR 0062, docs/WATER_SURFACE_GRID.md §2d) the water instead owes the time it hasn't run and runs it as fast as it can, at most threadStepBudget column-substeps a run (so it still answers edits and save requests between runs), and past maxOwedS of owed water time (water s, game time x speed: 360 is 5 real s at the 72x day) the rest is dropped and its clock slows. liquids: each liquid the grid moves (the first is the one it draws): its block, Manning's roughness (s/m^(1/3)), its weir coefficient (m^0.5/s; the generator sizes chute streams by it) and its running block (the generator's chute streams). Run `node shared/fluids/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/flow.gen.rs is stale.
